description: Source code for ROHC (Robust Header Compression) library engine, including compressor and decompressor classes, with functions for compression, decompression, and configuration management.

classes.name: rohc_lib_engine
classes.description: Main engine class for ROHC library, responsible for managing compressor and decompressor instances.

classes.name: rohc_lib_compressor
classes.description: Handles compression of data packets using ROHC protocol.

classes.name: rohc_lib_decompressor
classes.description: Handles decompression of data packets using ROHC protocol.

classes.name: rohc_decromp_result
classes.description: Structure to hold results from decompression, including decompressed packet and feedback.

methods.name: rohc_lib_engine
methods.description: Constructor for ROHC engine class, initializes logger and version info.

methods.name: rohc_lib_compressor
methods.description: Constructor for compressor, sets up profiles and buffers.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses input byte buffer into ROHC format.

methods.name: random_number_generator
methods.description: Generates random number for compressor RNG.

methods.name: rohc_lib_decompressor
methods.description: Constructor for decompressor, sets up profiles and buffers.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Decompresses input byte buffer from ROHC format.
